pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex, stellate geometry with irregular, jagged edge gradients. Patches exhibit high perimeter-to-area ratios with multiple acute-angled protrusions. Darker pigmentation is concentrated centrally within patches, fading towards serrated margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Thickness is non-uniform, with narrowing at points of high patch proximity. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial, forming an irregular lattice across the flank and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude bristly silhouette along the dorsal neck line, creating a fine-grained jagged contour against the background.
